No saved change is waiting for a restart.
Model, backup and voice changes need none: new chats pick them up; an open terminal chat keeps its
old setting until a fresh chat is started.
A Team Room change needs one only when the agents' system did not reload its add-ons; the desk
lists it here when that happens.
The desk restarts nothing itself. It leaves a request for the restart helper, which waits
for a quiet moment (no agent mid-reply, no job running) and then restarts the agents' system
The desk is in dry run (the desk was not started with --armed and the desk's armed switch is off):
Y only shows the request, it is not written.
Y = leave a restart request for the helper Esc = no, close
